definition_en: A wall or end structure built at the inlet or outlet of a culvert or drainage pipe to retain soil, protect the pipe end, and control erosion.
explanation_ru: Стенка или оголовок у входа либо выхода водопропускной трубы. Удерживает грунт, защищает конец трубы и помогает предотвратить размыв.
example_en: Construct the concrete headwall at the downstream end of the culvert.
scenario: A concrete wall is required around the end of a drainage pipe where it exits an embankment.
visual: Culvert pipe ending through a small retaining wall at a ditch, with soil held behind the wall.
common_mistakes: A headwall is the structure at a pipe end; it is not the culvert pipe itself.

definition_en: Large durable rock placed on slopes, channels, or around drainage outlets to resist erosion from flowing water.
explanation_ru: Крупный камень, уложенный для защиты откосов, канав и выпусков труб от размыва водой.
example_en: Place riprap at the culvert outlet to prevent erosion of the ditch.
scenario: Fast water leaving a pipe could wash away the exposed soil, so large rock is placed at the outlet.
visual: Pipe outlet discharging onto a fan-shaped apron of large rocks in a ditch.
common_mistakes: Riprap is erosion protection made from rock, not ordinary granular backfill.

definition_en: A broad shallow channel, often vegetated, shaped to collect, slow, and convey surface runoff.
explanation_ru: Широкая неглубокая водоотводная ложбина, часто покрытая травой. Собирает и направляет поверхностный сток.
example_en: Grade the boulevard swale to drain toward the catch basin.
scenario: Runoff crosses a landscaped area through a wide shallow depression rather than a narrow ditch.
visual: Wide shallow grassed depression between two higher ground surfaces with arrows showing runoff.
common_mistakes: A swale is typically wider and shallower than a conventional roadside ditch.

definition_en: Carefully exposing an existing underground utility at a specific location, often by hydrovac or vacuum excavation, to confirm its position and depth.
explanation_ru: Контрольное вскрытие существующей подземной коммуникации, часто гидроваком, чтобы точно подтвердить её положение и глубину перед работами.
translation_vi: đào thăm dò để lộ công trình ngầm
xác định vị trí tiện ích ngầm bằng đào hút
example_en: Daylight the existing gas line before excavating for the new storm crossing.
scenario: The drawings show an existing utility, but the crew must physically expose it before crossing nearby.
visual: Vacuum excavation hose exposing a small section of an existing buried utility without opening a full trench.
common_mistakes: In utility work, daylighting means exposing an existing buried utility; it does not mean general excavation.

definition_en: Prepared material placed directly beneath a pipe or utility to provide uniform support and establish the required grade.
explanation_ru: Подготовленный материал непосредственно под трубой, который создаёт ровную опору и помогает выдержать проектную отметку и уклон.
example_en: Place and level the pipe bedding before lowering the storm pipe into the trench.
scenario: A granular layer is prepared at the bottom of a trench so the pipe is continuously supported.
visual: Pipe cross-section in a trench with a highlighted granular layer directly below the pipe.
common_mistakes: Bedding is the support directly beneath the pipe; general backfill is placed later above and around the installation.

definition_en: Embedment material compacted along the lower sides of a pipe, typically from the bedding up toward the springline, to provide side support.
explanation_ru: Материал, тщательно уложенный и уплотнённый по бокам нижней части трубы. Он поддерживает трубу сбоку и является важной частью pipe embedment.
translation_vi: đắp chèn hai bên đáy ống
example_en: Compact the haunching evenly on both sides of the pipe before placing initial backfill.
scenario: Granular material must be worked tightly into the lower side areas beside a newly installed pipe.
visual: Pipe cross-section with wedge-shaped highlighted material on both lower sides between bedding and springline.
common_mistakes: Haunching is not simply material dumped over the pipe; it must support the lower sides of the pipe.

definition_en: A smaller branch pipe or connection that links a property, building, or customer to a main municipal utility.
explanation_ru: Ответвление от основной коммунальной сети к конкретному зданию, участку или потребителю.
translation_vi: nhánh đấu nối vào tuyến chính
example_en: Install the new water service connection from the watermain to the property line.
scenario: A small branch must connect one property to the larger municipal main.
visual: Large utility main with one smaller branch pipe extending toward a property line.
common_mistakes: A service connection serves an individual property or user; the main distributes service to many connections.

definition_en: A device installed in a pipe system to stop, start, isolate, or control flow.
explanation_ru: Арматура на трубопроводе, с помощью которой поток можно перекрыть, открыть или регулировать.
example_en: Close the existing valve before completing the watermain tie-in.
scenario: A section of pressurized pipe must be isolated without shutting down the entire network.
visual: Pressurized pipe with a gate valve symbol and an operating stem extending upward.

definition_en: An underground pipe system that carries wastewater from buildings to a treatment facility, generally separate from storm drainage.
explanation_ru: Подземная хозяйственно-бытовая канализация, которая отводит сточные воды от зданий к очистным сооружениям и обычно отделена от ливневой сети.
example_en: Maintain the specified separation between the sanitary sewer and the watermain.
scenario: Wastewater from buildings flows by gravity through an underground municipal pipe network.
visual: Building service pipes flowing into a gravity sewer main leading toward a treatment direction arrow.
common_mistakes: Sanitary sewer carries wastewater; storm sewer carries rainwater and surface runoff.

definition_en: A pressurized sewer pipe that carries wastewater pumped from a lift station or pump station rather than flowing only by gravity.
explanation_ru: Напорный канализационный трубопровод, по которому сточные воды перекачиваются насосом, например от насосной станции.
example_en: Connect the new pump station discharge to the existing force main.
scenario: Wastewater must travel uphill from a pump station through a pressurized pipe.
visual: Pump station connected to a pressurized pipe rising uphill, with flow arrows inside the pipe.
common_mistakes: A force main is pressurized by pumps; a typical sanitary sewer main usually relies on gravity.

definition_en: A layer of soil, aggregate, or backfill placed and compacted in one stage before the next layer is added.
explanation_ru: Один слой грунта или щебня, который укладывают определённой толщиной и уплотняют перед устройством следующего слоя.
example_en: Place the trench backfill in lifts and compact each lift before continuing.
scenario: Fill cannot be compacted effectively all at once, so it is placed in repeated horizontal layers.
visual: Three horizontal fill layers stacked vertically, with compaction arrows acting on one layer at a time.
common_mistakes: In earthworks, a lift is a placed layer of material, not lifting equipment.

definition_en: Earthwork where existing ground is excavated and lowered to reach the required design elevation or shape.
explanation_ru: Выемка: участок, где существующий грунт нужно снять, чтобы опустить поверхность до проектной отметки.
example_en: The west side of the site is mostly cut, with surplus material hauled to the fill area.
scenario: Existing ground is higher than design grade and material must be removed.
visual: Existing ground line above a lower design line, with the wedge between them highlighted as removed material.
common_mistakes: Cut removes material to lower grade; fill adds material to raise grade.

definition_en: Soil, aggregate, or other approved material placed to raise ground to the required design elevation or shape.
explanation_ru: Насыпь: материал, который добавляют для поднятия существующей поверхности до проектной отметки.
example_en: Use suitable excavated material as engineered fill where permitted.
scenario: Existing ground is below the design surface and approved material must be added and compacted.
visual: Existing ground line below a higher design line, with compacted material filling the space between them.
common_mistakes: Fill raises grade; backfill specifically refills an excavation around completed work.

definition_en: A field check where a loaded vehicle or heavy roller passes over prepared subgrade or aggregate to reveal soft, pumping, or unstable areas.
explanation_ru: Проверочный проход тяжёлой техникой по подготовленному основанию для выявления слабых, проседающих или переувлажнённых участков.
example_en: Proof-roll the subgrade and repair any soft areas before placing subbase.
scenario: A loaded truck crosses the prepared roadbed so weak spots can be identified before aggregate is placed.
visual: Loaded dump truck moving across subgrade with one soft area visibly deflecting under a wheel.
common_mistakes: Proof rolling identifies weak response; it is not itself a laboratory density test.

definition_en: The upper structural granular layer of a pavement system, typically placed above subbase and directly below asphalt or concrete pavement.
explanation_ru: Верхний несущий слой щебёночного основания дороги, обычно расположенный над subbase непосредственно под асфальтом или бетоном.
example_en: Place and compact the base course to final grade before paving.
scenario: The final granular structural layer is prepared immediately below the asphalt pavement.
visual: Road cross-section with asphalt on top, a highlighted granular base layer beneath it, then subbase and subgrade.
common_mistakes: Base course is generally above subbase and closer to the pavement surface.

definition_en: A thin application of asphalt emulsion placed between pavement layers to bond the new asphalt to the underlying surface.
explanation_ru: Тонкий слой битумной эмульсии между асфальтовыми слоями, который обеспечивает сцепление нового покрытия с существующей поверхностью.
example_en: Apply tack coat to the milled surface before placing the asphalt overlay.
scenario: A thin sticky emulsion is sprayed over existing pavement immediately before a new asphalt layer is placed.
visual: Existing pavement surface being spray-coated with a thin bonding layer before fresh asphalt is placed above.
common_mistakes: Tack coat bonds pavement layers; it is not a structural asphalt layer by itself.

definition_en: Temporary molds and supporting components used to shape and hold fresh concrete until it can support itself.
explanation_ru: Временная опалубка и её поддерживающие элементы, которые задают форму свежему бетону до набора им достаточной прочности.
example_en: Set the formwork and verify dimensions before placing concrete for the headwall.
scenario: Panels are assembled around reinforcement to create the required shape before concrete is poured.
visual: Rectangular concrete wall location enclosed by temporary form panels and braces.
common_mistakes: Formwork shapes concrete temporarily; it is normally removed after the concrete gains sufficient strength.

definition_en: Steel reinforcing bars embedded in concrete to improve tensile strength and control cracking.
explanation_ru: Стальная арматура внутри бетона, которая воспринимает растягивающие усилия и помогает контролировать трещинообразование.
example_en: Install the rebar cage before closing the wall formwork.
scenario: A grid of steel bars is tied inside a concrete structure before the concrete is placed.
visual: Grid of reinforcing bars inside a concrete wall outline with bar intersections tied together.

definition_en: A concrete restraint placed against undisturbed soil at bends, tees, caps, or other fittings in a pressurized pipeline to resist hydraulic thrust forces.
explanation_ru: Бетонный упор у фасонных частей напорного трубопровода. Передаёт усилие от давления воды в ненарушенный грунт и препятствует смещению трубы.
translation_vi: khối bê tông chống lực đẩy
example_en: Provide a thrust block at the watermain bend in accordance with the design details.
scenario: A pressurized pipe changes direction and needs a concrete restraint to prevent the fitting from moving.
visual: Pressurized pipe elbow with a concrete block bearing against undisturbed soil behind the fitting.
common_mistakes: A thrust block resists pipe forces; it is not simply concrete encasement around the whole pipe.

definition_en: An accessible box or vault in a conduit system used to pull, route, splice, or access electrical and communication cables.
explanation_ru: Доступная коробка или камера на кабельной трассе, через которую протягивают, направляют или обслуживают кабели.
example_en: Install the pull box at the change in duct bank alignment.
scenario: A long conduit run needs an accessible point where cables can be pulled and redirected.
visual: Underground conduit entering and leaving a rectangular access box with a removable lid at grade.
common_mistakes: A pull box provides cable access; it is not the same as a drainage catch basin.

definition_en: The defined horizontal path or centerline followed by a road, pipe, utility, or other linear feature.
explanation_ru: Заданная в плане трасса или ось дороги, трубопровода либо другой линейной конструкции.
example_en: Follow the proposed storm alignment shown on the plan drawings.
scenario: A pipe route curves across the site and all stationing is referenced along that path.
visual: Plan view showing a curved centerline with station ticks and offsets to nearby features.
common_mistakes: Alignment describes the path in plan; profile describes elevations along that path.

definition_en: A longitudinal vertical view along an alignment showing elevations, grades, pipes, structures, and changes in ground level.
explanation_ru: Продольный профиль по трассе: вертикальное представление отметок, уклонов, существующей и проектной поверхности, труб и колодцев.
example_en: Check the storm profile for pipe slopes and manhole invert elevations.
scenario: The drawing shows distance horizontally and elevation vertically along the centerline of a road or pipe.
visual: Longitudinal chart with stationing along the bottom and existing ground, design grade, and pipe lines plotted by elevation.
common_mistakes: A profile is a vertical longitudinal view; plan view is viewed from above.

definition_en: A drawing viewed from above that shows horizontal locations, dimensions, alignments, and relationships between site features.
explanation_ru: Вид сверху на объект, где показывают плановое положение дорог, сетей, зданий, размеров и привязок.
example_en: Use the plan view to measure the horizontal length of the proposed watermain.
scenario: You need to see where utilities run across the site relative to roads and property lines.
visual: Top-down civil drawing with roadway edges, property lines, utility centerlines, and dimensions.
common_mistakes: Plan view shows horizontal layout; profile shows elevations along an alignment.

definition_en: Request for Information: a formal question asking the owner, consultant, or designer to clarify missing, conflicting, or ambiguous project information.
explanation_ru: Официальный запрос разъяснения по проекту, когда чертежи, спецификации или условия тендера неполные, противоречивые или неоднозначные.
translation_vi: yêu cầu làm rõ thông tin
example_en: Submit an RFI to confirm the pavement restoration limits before bid closing.
scenario: Two tender documents conflict and the estimator needs a formal clarification from the consultant.
visual: Question document sent from contractor to consultant, with a formal response arrow returning to the project team.
common_mistakes: An RFI asks for clarification; an RFQ asks a supplier or subcontractor for pricing.

definition_en: A formal pre-bid document issued by the owner or consultant that changes, clarifies, or adds to the tender documents.
explanation_ru: Официальное дополнение к тендерной документации, выпущенное до закрытия тендера. Может менять чертежи, спецификации, сроки или условия предложения.
translation_vi: phụ lục hồ sơ mời thầu
văn bản bổ sung hồ sơ thầu
example_en: Review Addendum 2 and update the quantities before finalizing the bid.
scenario: The consultant issues a document before closing that changes a drawing and extends the bid date.
visual: Tender document stack with a new numbered addendum sheet placed on top and change arrows pointing to drawings and closing date.
common_mistakes: An addendum is an official tender change; an RFI response may clarify information but does not always modify the contract documents in the same way.

definition_en: A price assigned to one unit of measured work, such as dollars per metre, square metre, cubic metre, tonne, or each.
explanation_ru: Цена за одну единицу измеряемой работы или материала: например, за метр трубы, квадратный метр асфальта или кубический метр выемки.
example_en: Apply the unit price to the measured pipe quantity to calculate the bid item amount.
scenario: The tender pays for actual installed quantity multiplied by a rate per metre.
visual: Estimate row showing quantity multiplied by a rate per unit to produce an extended amount.
common_mistakes: Unit price is a rate per measured unit; lump sum is one total price for a defined scope.

definition_en: One total price for completing a defined scope of work, rather than payment based on measured quantities for each unit.
explanation_ru: Одна фиксированная общая цена за выполнение определённого объёма работ без отдельной оплаты каждой фактической единицы количества.
example_en: Carry traffic control as a lump-sum item unless the tender form requires unit pricing.
scenario: The contractor is paid one agreed total amount for the complete defined scope.
visual: Scope checklist feeding into one single total-price box rather than quantity-times-rate rows.
common_mistakes: Lump sum does not mean the scope is undefined; it means the defined scope is priced as one total amount.

definition_en: The amount of work a crew or resource can complete in a given period of time, used to estimate duration and cost.
explanation_ru: Производительность бригады или техники: сколько метров, кубометров, штук и т. п. можно выполнить за час, смену или день.
example_en: Use a realistic production rate for deep storm installation when calculating crew hours.
scenario: An estimator needs to convert 600 metres of pipe into the number of crew days required to install it.
visual: Quantity divided by metres-per-day rate to produce required workdays, shown as an estimating flow diagram.
common_mistakes: Production rate is output per time; it is not the same as a unit price.

definition_en: A reserve amount carried to cover identified or general uncertainty and risk that may affect project cost.
explanation_ru: Резерв на неопределённость и риски, которые могут увеличить стоимость работ. Его назначение и допустимость зависят от типа сметы и условий тендера.
example_en: Keep design contingency separate from the owner-specified allowance in the estimate review.
scenario: The estimator adds a risk reserve because several quantities and field conditions remain uncertain.
visual: Estimate total with a separate risk-reserve line below measured cost and above final total.
common_mistakes: Contingency is generally a risk reserve; an allowance is usually a defined amount tied to a particular uncertain scope or cost.

definition_en: Based on measuring or calculating three-dimensional volume, usually expressed in cubic units such as cubic metres.
explanation_ru: Объёмный, то есть связанный с расчётом трёхмерного объёма. В civil estimating так часто называют расчёт выемки и насыпи в кубических метрах по существующей и проектной поверхностям.
example_en: The volumetric earthworks analysis showed a surplus of excavated material on the site.
scenario: An estimator compares existing and proposed terrain surfaces to calculate cut and fill in cubic metres.
visual: Two terrain surfaces over a gridded footprint, with the three-dimensional space between them divided into cut and fill volumes.
common_mistakes: Volumetric describes a calculation or measurement based on volume; volume is the quantity itself.
Do not confuse cubic metres of in-situ soil with loose or compacted cubic metres because bulking and shrinkage can change the quantity.

definition_en: A factory-made bend or elbow used with fibreglass reinforced epoxy (FRE) conduit to change direction in an electrical or communication conduit run, including underground duct-bank work.
explanation_ru: Заводской отвод или изгиб для кабельной трубы FRE (fibreglass reinforced epoxy). Его ставят там, где трасса conduit меняет направление; в duct bank такой отвод позволяет выполнить плавный поворот для последующей протяжки кабеля.
translation_vi: ống cong sợi thủy tinh epoxy
example_en: Include the required FRE bends where the duct bank changes direction before entering the pull box.
scenario: An underground electrical conduit run turns toward an access structure, so the estimator must carry factory-made fiberglass sweep fittings at the change in direction.
visual: Plan-and-profile schematic of an underground conduit changing direction through a smooth long-radius fiberglass bend, with straight conduit on both sides and cable-pull arrows through the curve.
common_mistakes: An FRE bend is a factory-made fitting for an FRE conduit system, not simply a field-bent length of ordinary PVC conduit.
FRE in this context means fibreglass reinforced epoxy; verify the specified conduit standard, manufacturer, bend radius, and joint system before pricing or ordering.

definition_en: A fitting used to join two lengths of electrical duct or conduit in a continuous run.
explanation_ru: Соединительная муфта для стыковки двух отрезков кабельной трубы (duct/conduit) в одну непрерывную трассу. В duct bank coupling учитывают как отдельный fitting, если он предусмотрен системой труб и способом соединения.
example_en: Install a duct coupling at each conduit joint in accordance with the specified duct system.
scenario: Two straight sections of underground electrical conduit must be joined end-to-end before the duct bank is encased or backfilled.
visual: Two straight conduit sections aligned end-to-end with a wider coupling sleeve centered over the joint and arrows showing the connection.
common_mistakes: A duct coupling joins straight conduit sections; it is not a bend used to change direction.
Coupling type and installation method depend on the specified conduit system, so verify the project specifications and manufacturer requirements.

definition_en: A temporary sediment-control barrier made of geotextile fabric supported by posts and installed along contours or downslope of disturbed soil to slow runoff and trap sediment.
explanation_ru: Временный противоэрозионный барьер из геотекстильной ткани на стойках. Его устанавливают ниже по уклону от нарушенного грунта, чтобы замедлить поверхностный сток и задержать частицы грунта до того, как вода уйдёт за пределы рабочей зоны.
translation_vi: hàng rào vải địa kỹ thuật giữ bùn đất
example_en: Install the silt fence along the downslope limit of disturbance before starting excavation.
scenario: Earthworks expose bare soil near the edge of the site, so a temporary fabric barrier is installed to keep sediment-laden runoff from leaving the work area.
visual: Side view of disturbed soil sloping toward a geotextile fence supported by posts, with runoff arrows slowing at the fabric and sediment accumulating on the upstream side.
common_mistakes: A silt fence is intended to trap sediment from shallow sheet flow; it should not be used as a dam across concentrated drainage flow.
The bottom of the fabric normally needs to be trenched or otherwise anchored as required by the project detail; simply standing fabric on grade can allow runoff to pass underneath.

definition_en: A spacer or support used to hold multiple electrical ducts or conduits at the required separation and arrangement within a duct bank.
explanation_ru: Дистанционный фиксатор или распорка, которая удерживает несколько кабельных труб (duct/conduit) на заданном расстоянии и в правильной конфигурации внутри duct bank, особенно перед и во время бетонной обоймы.
translation_vi: giá định vị ống luồn cáp
miếng đệm giữ khoảng cách ống cáp
example_en: Install duct spacers at the specified intervals to maintain conduit separation before concrete encasement.
scenario: A multi-duct electrical bank has two rows of conduits that must stay evenly spaced and aligned while the assembly is placed and concrete is poured around it.
visual: Duct-bank cross-section showing six conduits held in a two-row grid by spacer bars that maintain equal horizontal and vertical separation.
common_mistakes: A duct spacer positions and separates conduits; it does not join conduit lengths like a duct coupling.
Spacer type, spacing along the run, and required conduit separation must be taken from the project detail or manufacturer system rather than assumed.

definition_en: Final asphalt pavement restoration in which a specified depth of existing pavement is milled over a defined area and replaced with a new asphalt overlay to provide a permanent finished surface.
explanation_ru: Окончательное восстановление асфальтового покрытия: существующий асфальт фрезеруют на заданную глубину в установленных пределах, после чего укладывают новый слой асфальта. Обычно это постоянное восстановление после временного патча, траншейных работ или других вскрытий.
translation_ru: постоянное восстановление методом фрезеровки и нового асфальтового слоя
translation_vi: phục hồi mặt đường vĩnh viễn bằng cào bóc và thảm phủ asphalt
cào bóc và thảm lại lớp asphalt hoàn thiện
example_en: Complete the permanent mill and overlay after utility installation and temporary pavement restoration are accepted.
scenario: A utility trench was temporarily patched. Before final project completion, the road surface is milled across the specified restoration limits and a continuous new asphalt lift is placed to create the permanent finished pavement.
visual: Road cross-section and plan view showing a temporary trench patch within a wider rectangular milling limit, with the upper asphalt layer removed and replaced by a continuous permanent overlay.
common_mistakes: Permanent mill and overlay is not the same as a temporary trench patch; it is the final restoration treatment.
The milling depth and restoration limits must be taken from the drawings, specifications, municipal standards, or bid item description rather than assumed from the trench width.

definition_en: A modular duct-bank spacer that locks or snaps together with adjacent spacer sections to hold multiple conduits at the required spacing and arrangement.
explanation_ru: Модульный фиксатор для duct bank, отдельные секции которого защёлкиваются или соединяются друг с другом. Он удерживает несколько conduit на заданном расстоянии и помогает собрать стабильную сетку труб перед обратной засыпкой или бетонной обоймой.
translation_vi: giá định vị ống luồn cáp liên kết
miếng đệm ống cáp lắp ghép
example_en: Install each interlock spacer at the specified interval so the conduits remain aligned and evenly separated.
scenario: A multi-duct electrical bank uses modular spacer sections that connect together around the conduits to maintain the required horizontal and vertical separation along the run.
visual: Duct-bank cross-section showing six conduits supported by modular spacer sections that interlock at their edges to form one continuous spacer grid.
common_mistakes: An interlock spacer is a specific modular type of duct spacer; not every duct spacer uses an interlocking or snap-together design.
Spacer configuration and spacing along the run must follow the project detail or manufacturer requirements; do not assume a standard grid or interval.

definition_en: A spacer assembly used to support, separate, and maintain the alignment of multiple conduits installed inside a casing or bored crossing, while allowing the conduit bundle to be pulled or pushed into position and, where required, grouted.
explanation_ru: Специальный фиксатор для нескольких кабельных труб внутри casing или бурового перехода. Он удерживает conduits на заданном расстоянии и в правильной конфигурации при протяжке или установке через переход; конструкция часто предусматривает свободное прохождение grout вокруг труб.
translation_ru: дистанционный фиксатор conduit в буровом переходе
распорка для кабельных труб внутри casing
translation_vi: giá định vị ống trong ống vỏ
spacer cho ống luồn cáp trong đoạn khoan
bộ giữ khoảng cách ống trong casing
example_en: Install each bore spacer at the specified interval to keep the conduits aligned within the casing before grouting.
scenario: Several electrical conduits must pass beneath a roadway inside a large casing. Bore spacers support the conduit bundle, maintain separation during installation, and help preserve grout flow paths around the conduits.
visual: Cross-section of a large circular casing containing multiple conduits held in a fixed pattern by a bore spacer, with open paths around the conduits for grout flow.
common_mistakes: A bore spacer is used for conduit-in-casing or bored-crossing installations; a typical duct spacer is generally used to maintain conduit spacing in an open trench or conventional duct bank.
Do not assume the spacer configuration or interval. Casing diameter, conduit count and size, installation method, grout requirements, and manufacturer design can change the required bore spacer.

definition_en: A chair-style support used in underground conduit or duct-bank work to hold conduits at the required elevation and spacing during assembly and encasement.
explanation_ru: Опора типа «стул» для conduit/duct bank. Поддерживает трубы на нужной высоте и помогает сохранять требуемые интервалы между ними во время сборки и бетонной обоймы.
translation_vi: giá đỡ dạng ghế cho ống luồn cáp
spacer dạng ghế cho duct bank
example_en: Place each chair spacer at the specified interval so the lower conduit tier remains supported during concrete placement.
scenario: A concrete-encased duct bank needs its lower row of conduits held above the trench base before the next conduit tier is assembled.
visual: Duct-bank side and cross-section view showing a chair-shaped support beneath a conduit row, holding the ducts above the base.
common_mistakes: Chair spacer terminology can vary by manufacturer; verify the project detail before assuming a specific shape or load rating.
Do not confuse a conduit chair spacer with a rebar chair used only to support reinforcing steel.

definition_en: A spacer or support with a cradle-shaped seat that supports conduit from below and helps maintain its required position within a duct-bank or casing assembly.
explanation_ru: Spacer с седловидной/люлькообразной опорой снизу, в которую укладывается conduit. Он помогает удерживать трубу в заданном положении внутри duct bank или casing. Название и форма могут отличаться у разных производителей.
translation_vi: giá đỡ dạng máng cho ống luồn cáp
spacer dạng cradle cho ống cáp
example_en: Use the cradle spacer shown on the detail to support the conduit bundle through the crossing.
scenario: A conduit bundle needs shaped supports that seat the ducts from below while preserving the intended alignment through a crossing.
visual: Cross-section showing conduits resting in curved cradle-shaped seats that support the lower half of each duct.
common_mistakes: Cradle spacer is not a universal standardized product name; use the project drawing or manufacturer terminology to confirm the intended spacer.
A cradle spacer supports and positions conduit; it is not a conduit coupling or joint fitting.

definition_en: A saddle-shaped spacer or support used to locate and restrain conduit at a required position or separation within an underground conduit assembly.
explanation_ru: Spacer седловидной формы, который фиксирует положение conduit и помогает выдержать требуемый зазор в подземной сборке. В разных системах saddle может охватывать трубу частично или служить опорой под ней.
translation_vi: spacer dạng yên đỡ ống luồn cáp
giá đỡ dạng saddle cho ống cáp
example_en: Install the saddle spacer where shown to restrain the conduit and maintain the specified separation.
scenario: A conduit run requires shaped supports at intervals so individual ducts do not shift while the surrounding assembly is installed.
visual: Conduit cross-section seated in a saddle-shaped support with dimension arrows indicating maintained clearance.
common_mistakes: Do not automatically interpret saddle spacer as a wall-mounted conduit saddle; in underground work the term may refer to a duct-support spacer.
Project and manufacturer details control the exact saddle shape and spacing.

definition_en: A one-piece plate-style conduit spacer with openings or cutouts that locate multiple ducts in a fixed pattern, commonly used as a rigid alternative to individual chair-style supports.
explanation_ru: Жёсткий spacer в виде цельной пластины/карты с отверстиями или вырезами под несколько conduit. Он фиксирует всю конфигурацию труб как единую сетку и обычно жёстче отдельных chair-style supports.
translation_vi: tấm spacer đặc định vị ống luồn cáp
tấm định vị ống dạng liền khối
example_en: Use the solid plate spacer to maintain the six-duct configuration and required separation through the run.
scenario: Six conduits must remain in a fixed two-by-three pattern, so a rigid plate with conduit openings is installed at specified intervals.
visual: Front view of a solid rectangular spacer plate with six circular conduit openings arranged in a fixed grid.
common_mistakes: Solid plate spacer describes the spacer construction, not the conduit material or a solid cover plate.
Plate thickness, opening size, and conduit separation must match the approved spacer design or project detail.

definition_en: A fabricated spacer made from welded bars, wire, or sections arranged as a grid to hold multiple conduits in a defined pattern and maintain separation.
explanation_ru: Сварной spacer-каркас из прутков, проволоки или профилей, образующих сетку для фиксации нескольких conduit в заданной конфигурации и с нужными зазорами.
translation_vi: khung spacer lưới hàn cho ống luồn cáp
giá định vị ống bằng lưới hàn
example_en: Install the welded grid spacer at the specified stations to keep the conduit bundle aligned through the crossing.
scenario: A custom conduit bundle requires a fabricated rigid grid rather than a molded plastic spacer, so welded members form the required duct openings.
visual: Front view of a welded rectangular grid forming multiple conduit cells, with circular ducts passing through the cells.
common_mistakes: Welded grid spacer is a fabrication description and may be project-specific rather than a universal product category.
Do not substitute a metallic welded grid where project requirements call for non-magnetic or non-metallic spacers without approval.

definition_en: A spacer support installed at the bottom of a conduit or duct-bank assembly to support the lowest conduit tier and establish the required clearance and spacing above the trench base or foundation.
explanation_ru: Нижний spacer, который устанавливают под первым рядом conduit в duct bank. Он поддерживает нижний ряд труб, задаёт их положение и обеспечивает требуемый зазор от основания траншеи или бетонной подготовки.
translation_vi: giá đỡ hàng ống dưới cùng
bộ định vị đáy ống luồn cáp
example_en: Install each base spacer at the specified interval before placing the first conduit tier.
scenario: The first row of conduits must be held off the trench base at a consistent elevation before intermediate spacers and additional conduit tiers are assembled.
visual: Duct-bank cross-section showing the lowest conduit row resting on a base spacer above the trench bottom, with a dimension indicating bottom clearance.
common_mistakes: A base spacer supports the lowest conduit tier; it is not the same component as an intermediate spacer installed between conduit rows.
Base-spacer height and spacing must follow the project detail or manufacturer system because they control conduit elevation and concrete cover.

definition_en: A modular interlocking spacer installed between conduit tiers to maintain vertical and horizontal separation and to connect successive layers of a multi-tier duct-bank assembly.
explanation_ru: Промежуточный защёлкивающийся spacer между рядами conduit. Он фиксирует расстояние между уровнями труб и соединяется с соседними spacer-элементами, формируя многоярусную сетку duct bank.
translation_vi: bộ định vị liên kết giữa các tầng ống
spacer khóa giữa các hàng ống
example_en: Install each intermediate interlock spacer between conduit tiers to maintain the required duct separation.
scenario: After the bottom conduit row is set on base spacers, additional rows are stacked above it using interlocking intermediate spacer sections that keep the full duct-bank grid aligned.
visual: Multi-tier duct-bank cross-section showing a base spacer below the first row and intermediate interlock spacer sections between the lower and upper conduit tiers.
common_mistakes: An intermediate interlock spacer is installed between conduit tiers; it should not be confused with the base spacer beneath the lowest tier.
The interlocking profile, conduit spacing, and number of tiers are system-specific and should be verified against the project detail or manufacturer requirements.

definition_en: A pedestrian walkway constructed of cast-in-place concrete, typically placed beside a curb, boulevard, roadway, or building frontage.
explanation_ru: Бетонный тротуар для пешеходов, обычно устраиваемый вдоль бордюра, бульвара, дороги или здания. В смете обычно учитываются площадь бетона, подготовка основания, формы, швы и восстановление примыканий.
translation_vi: lối đi bộ bằng bê tông
example_en: Replace the concrete sidewalk within the restoration limits after the utility work is complete.
scenario: A utility crossing disturbs an existing sidewalk, so the affected panels are removed and reconstructed to the project or municipal standard.
visual: Plan and cross-section showing a concrete sidewalk panel beside curb and gutter, with slab thickness, base material, and panel joints.
common_mistakes: Concrete sidewalk refers to the pedestrian slab, not the curb and gutter beside it.
Restoration limits may extend to full panels or nearest joints; do not assume the replacement area is only the trench width.

definition_en: A raised edge, usually concrete or stone, installed along the side of a roadway, sidewalk, median, or landscaped area to define the boundary and help control drainage and vehicle movement.
explanation_ru: Бордюр — приподнятый бетонный или каменный край вдоль дороги, тротуара, островка или озеленённой зоны. Он отделяет поверхности, удерживает край покрытия и может направлять поверхностную воду. В Канаде и США чаще пишут curb; kerb — британское написание.
example_en: Replace the damaged kerb along the edge of the sidewalk before final paving.
scenario: A utility excavation damages the raised roadway edge, so the existing concrete edge element is removed and reconstructed before adjacent asphalt and sidewalk restoration.
visual: Road-edge cross-section showing a raised kerb between asphalt pavement and sidewalk, with the kerb clearly highlighted.
common_mistakes: Kerb and curb mean the same roadway-edge element; kerb is British spelling, while curb is more common in Canadian and U.S. drawings.
A kerb is not always combined with a gutter; curb and gutter is a specific combined profile.

definition_en: A factory-formed enlarged socket at one end of a conduit or duct length that receives the plain (spigot) end of the next length to make a joint.
explanation_ru: Заводской раструб, сформированный на конце conduit/duct. В него вставляют гладкий (spigot) конец следующей трубы, чтобы соединить секции без отдельной муфты, если система рассчитана на такое соединение.
translation_vi: đầu loe tích hợp của ống luồn cáp
example_en: Insert the plain end of the next conduit fully into the integral bell end in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
scenario: One end of each conduit length is factory-enlarged into a socket so the next straight section can slide into it.
visual: Side view of two conduit lengths showing a straight spigot end sliding into the enlarged socket formed on the adjacent conduit.
common_mistakes: An integral bell end is formed as part of the conduit length; a separate coupling is a different fitting.
Some catalogs also use “bell end” for separate end fittings, so verify the specified product and connection detail.

definition_en: A closure fitting used to seal or protect the open end of a conduit or duct, temporarily or permanently, so dirt, water, concrete, and debris cannot enter.
explanation_ru: Колпак или заглушка для закрытия открытого конца conduit/duct. Нужна, чтобы в запасную или временно неиспользуемую трубу не попали грунт, вода, бетон и мусор.
example_en: Install a conduit cap / plug on each spare conduit before backfilling the duct bank.
scenario: A spare underground raceway is left unused after installation and its open end must be closed so soil and concrete cannot enter.
visual: Side-by-side detail showing a cap fitting over the outside of one conduit end and a plug closing the opening of another conduit end.
common_mistakes: A cap normally covers the outside of an open end, while a plug blocks the opening; the exact fitting style depends on the conduit system.
Do not assume a temporary shipping cap satisfies the permanent project requirement.

definition_en: A fitting used to connect a conduit or duct to a different size, material, connection style, fitting, or equipment entry when the two ends do not mate directly.
explanation_ru: Переходник для conduit/duct. Он соединяет кабельную трубу с другим размером, материалом, типом соединения, fitting или вводом оборудования, когда напрямую состыковать элементы нельзя.
example_en: Use the specified conduit adaptor where the FRE duct transitions to the equipment connection.
scenario: An underground raceway reaches another system with a different end connection, so a purpose-made transition fitting is required.
visual: Two conduit sections with different end sizes and connection profiles joined by a short transition fitting between them.
common_mistakes: An adaptor does not necessarily reduce diameter; it may change size, material, thread, socket type, or equipment connection.
Verify the exact adaptor type and compatible conduit system before pricing or ordering.

definition_en: A light cord installed or left inside a conduit so a cable, pulling rope, or heavier line can be drawn through the conduit later.
explanation_ru: Лёгкая протяжка, оставленная внутри conduit. За неё позже протягивают более прочный трос или сам кабель, поэтому запасную трубу можно подготовить заранее для будущей кабельной установки.
translation_vi: dây kéo luồn sẵn trong ống
example_en: Leave a pull string in each spare conduit and secure both ends for future cable installation.
scenario: A spare raceway is installed now, but the cable will be installed later; a light cord is left inside to make the future pull easier.
visual: Long conduit with a thin cord running through the full length, with the cord ends secured and arrows indicating a future cable pull.
common_mistakes: A pull string is not the electrical cable itself and may only be used to pull in a stronger rope before the final cable pull.
Required pull-line material and strength depend on the project specification and installation method.

definition_en: A curved conduit section or fitting used to change the direction of a raceway while maintaining a smooth path for cable installation and pulling.
explanation_ru: Отвод или изгиб кабельной трубы, который меняет направление трассы conduit. Для кабельной протяжки важен плавный радиус; конкретный угол и радиус берут из проекта, спецификаций и системы производителя.
example_en: Provide a conduit bend at the change in alignment before the run enters the pull box.
scenario: A straight underground raceway must turn toward an access structure without creating a sharp corner that would obstruct cable pulling.
visual: Plan-and-profile schematic showing straight conduit transitioning through a smooth curved section into a new direction.
common_mistakes: Do not assume the bend radius or allowable number of bends; use the project requirements and the specified conduit system.
A bend changes direction; a coupling joins sections without intentionally changing alignment.

definition_en: In electrical and utility conduit work, FRE commonly refers to fibreglass reinforced epoxy, a nonmetallic composite used for rigid conduit and compatible fittings.
explanation_ru: В кабельных и utility-системах FRE обычно означает fibreglass reinforced epoxy — стекловолокно, армированное/связанное эпоксидной смолой. Из него делают жёсткие conduit и совместимые fittings, включая bends, adaptors и caps.
translation_vi: composite sợi thủy tinh gia cường epoxy
FRE — vật liệu sợi thủy tinh epoxy
example_en: Use FRE conduit and compatible fittings where the project specification calls for a fibreglass reinforced epoxy raceway system.
scenario: A specification calls for a lightweight, corrosion-resistant nonmetallic raceway made from glass fibres bonded with epoxy resin.
visual: Cutaway of a rigid conduit wall showing wound glass-fibre reinforcement embedded in an epoxy resin matrix.
common_mistakes: FRE identifies a fibreglass-reinforced-epoxy conduit material or system; do not assume all fibreglass conduit products have identical ratings or joint systems.
Always verify the specified standard, approved manufacturer, fitting system, and installation requirements for the project.

definition_en: A telescopic belt-conveyor material-placement system, commonly truck-mounted, used to convey and place concrete, aggregate, sand, gravel, backfill, and other flowable bulk materials at locations that are difficult to reach directly.
explanation_ru: Telebelt — телескопический ленточный конвейер для подачи материала по площадке. Обычно это машина на шасси с выдвижной конвейерной стрелой: материал загружают в приёмный бункер, а лента переносит его к месту укладки. В civil работах Telebelt используют для бетона, щебня, песка, гравия, backfill и других сыпучих материалов, когда самосвал или бетонный миксер не может подъехать непосредственно к точке укладки.
translation_vi: xe băng tải telescopic để cấp vật liệu
example_en: Use a Telebelt to place granular backfill behind the structure where dump trucks cannot safely access.
scenario: A crew needs to move a large volume of granular material from an accessible loading point to a placement area behind a structure, without repeatedly moving small equipment through the work zone.
visual: Side-view schematic of a truck-mounted telescopic conveyor receiving material at a hopper and extending a long belt boom over an obstruction to discharge into a controlled placement area.
common_mistakes: Telebelt is a Putzmeister brand name; the generic equipment type is a telescopic belt conveyor.
Do not assume a Telebelt is only for concrete. Depending on the model and project requirements, it can place many flowable bulk materials such as aggregate, sand, gravel, and backfill.
For estimating, check mobilization, reach, setup space, outriggers, material compatibility, production needs, and whether a loader, dump truck, or mixer is required to feed the hopper.

definition_en: An above-ground outlet connected to a pressurized water distribution system, used mainly to supply water for firefighting and sometimes for flushing or testing.
explanation_ru: Надземный пожарный гидрант, подключённый к напорной водопроводной сети. Через него пожарные получают большой расход воды; на civil-проектах estimator обычно учитывает сам гидрант, ответвление от watermain, запорную арматуру, земляные работы и восстановление покрытия.
example_en: Install the hydrant on the new watermain branch at the location shown on the civil plan.
scenario: A vertical above-ground fitting is connected to the municipal water distribution system so firefighters can quickly access a high-flow water supply.
visual: Civil utility section showing an above-ground fire hydrant connected by a short branch pipe to a buried watermain.
common_mistakes: A hydrant is connected to the pressurized water distribution system; it is not a sanitary or storm drainage structure.
For estimating, do not count only the hydrant body—check the branch connection, valve, fittings, excavation, backfill, testing, and surface restoration required by the project.

definition_en: Large-scale excavation over a broad area to remove substantial volumes of soil, rock, or other material, usually to reach formation level, create a large foundation excavation, or reshape a site.
explanation_ru: Массовая разработка грунта на большой площади — не узкая траншея, а значительный объём выемки для котлована, понижения площадки или выхода на проектную отметку. Для estimator важно отдельно учитывать объём, производительность экскаваторов, погрузку, haul/disposal или reuse, доступ техники, воду и необходимость откосов либо shoring.
example_en: Carry the bulk excavation separately from utility trench excavation so production and haul assumptions can be priced correctly.
scenario: A large open area must be lowered several metres, with excavators loading trucks continuously rather than digging a narrow utility trench.
visual: Wide open excavation with sloped sides, an excavator loading dump trucks, and a broad design formation level at the bottom.
common_mistakes: Bulk excavation is large-area or large-volume excavation; do not treat every narrow utility trench as bulk excavation.
For estimating, confirm whether loading, hauling, disposal, reuse, dewatering, access, slopes, or temporary support are separate scope items.

definition_en: Excavation made specifically to form the trenches, pads, or localized cuts required for concrete footings and foundation elements.
explanation_ru: Выемка грунта именно под footing — ленточный или отдельный фундамент. Обычно это более локальная и точная excavation, чем bulk excavation: нужно учитывать ширину и глубину footing, рабочее пространство, over-excavation, ручную подчистку, вывоз грунта и последующую работу formwork/rebar.
example_en: Price the footing excavation separately from the bulk excavation because the footing trenches require more precise digging and cleanup.
scenario: After the main site cut is complete, narrower and deeper localized excavations are dug along the building foundation lines for concrete footings.
visual: Foundation section showing a narrow footing excavation below general formation level with the concrete footing footprint outlined at the bottom.
common_mistakes: Footing excavation is not the same as the entire bulk site excavation; it is the localized cut needed for foundation footings.
Check whether working room, over-excavation, hand trimming, disposal, shoring, dewatering, or backfill are measured separately.

definition_en: Plumbing piping and fittings installed below finished grade or below a slab/foundation zone before concrete and backfill make the work inaccessible.
explanation_ru: Подземная plumbing-разводка, которую прокладывают до бетонирования и обратной засыпки. В зоне фундаментов трубы могут проходить внутри или через footing excavation либо под slab; estimator должен проверить трассу, sleeves/penetrations, excavation, bedding, connections и координацию с footing concrete.
example_en: Coordinate the below-grade plumbing within the footing areas before the concrete crew places the footings and slab.
scenario: Sanitary or water piping must be installed through the foundation zone before the concrete work closes access to the excavation.
visual: Foundation section showing buried plumbing piping routed through the footing excavation and beneath the future slab, with a sleeve/penetration at the foundation zone.
common_mistakes: Do not assume every pipe near a footing is cast directly inside structural concrete; verify the structural and plumbing drawings for sleeves, clearances, and routing.
Below-grade plumbing is broader than exterior municipal utility work and may include building sanitary, water, or other plumbing below the slab/foundation.

definition_en: The improvement or reinforcement of soil so it can safely support excavation, temporary works, foundations, traffic, or construction operations.
explanation_ru: Стабилизация грунта — меры для повышения устойчивости или несущей способности грунта. Это может быть уплотнение, замена, смешивание с вяжущими, инъектирование, армирование и другие методы; конкретный метод выбирают по проекту и геотехническим условиям.
example_en: The shoring design may require soil stabilization before the excavation advances.
scenario: Weak or moving ground beside a deep cut needs to be strengthened so the excavation and nearby structures remain stable.
visual: Excavation cross-section showing weak soil beside a cut being improved in a treated zone before deeper digging.
common_mistakes: Soil stabilization is a broad concept; it is not automatically the same as shoring.
Do not assume a treatment method without the geotechnical design or specification.

definition_en: A tensioned ground anchor installed through or behind a retaining or shoring wall to transfer lateral loads into competent soil or rock.
explanation_ru: Анкерная тяга для шоринга: буровой анкер проходит через стену или за стену котлована и передаёт растягивающее усилие в устойчивый грунт или скалу. Часто такие анкеры называют ground anchors или shoring anchors.
example_en: The temporary shoring system includes a tieback anchor at each designed anchor elevation.
scenario: A deep excavation wall needs lateral restraint without internal braces blocking the work area, so tensioned elements are drilled back into the ground.
visual: Shoring wall cross-section with an inclined tension anchor extending behind the wall into a bonded soil zone.
common_mistakes: A tieback anchor is not the same as a trench box or internal strut.
Anchor length, angle, bond zone, testing, and grouting are engineered requirements.

definition_en: Localized, relatively precise excavation for specific structural or utility features such as footings, pits, trenches, chambers, or grade changes after or alongside the main site cut.
explanation_ru: Детальная разработка грунта — локальные точные выемки под отдельные элементы: footings, pits, trenches, chambers и т. п. В отличие от bulk excavation, здесь считают каждую локальную выемку и внимательно следят за глубинами и пересечениями.
translation_vi: đào cục bộ theo cấu kiện
example_en: Measure the detailed excavation separately from the bulk excavation to avoid mixing the two quantities.
scenario: After the main building platform is cut down, smaller precise pits and trenches still have to be measured around foundations and services.
visual: Site section with a broad bulk cut and several smaller precise pits and trenches highlighted below it.
common_mistakes: Detailed excavation is not simply another name for all excavation.
Avoid double counting areas already included in the bulk cut or another detailed excavation item.

definition_en: The enlarged lower part of a foundation that spreads structural loads from a wall, column, or core into the supporting soil or rock.
explanation_ru: Фундаментная подошва или отдельная фундаментная часть, которая распределяет нагрузку от стены, колонны или ядра здания на грунт. Footing может быть ленточным, отдельным, ступенчатым и т. д.
example_en: Excavate the footing to the specified bearing elevation before placing reinforcing steel and concrete.
scenario: A column or wall transfers load into a wider concrete base bearing on soil or rock.
visual: Section showing a wall or column bearing on a wider reinforced concrete base below grade.
common_mistakes: A footing is the load-spreading foundation element, not the excavation around it.
Do not assume every footing has the same shape or requires formwork.

definition_en: A continuous footing that runs beneath a wall or a line of closely spaced supports and distributes their load along a strip.
explanation_ru: Ленточный фундамент — непрерывная бетонная подошва под стеной или линией опор. В takeoff обычно измеряется по длине, ширине и глубине, а excavation может идти непрерывной траншеей.
example_en: Measure each strip footing along the wall line and use the structural elevations for excavation depth.
scenario: A long foundation base follows the same line as a structural wall instead of appearing as isolated pads.
visual: Plan and section showing a continuous concrete foundation strip below a wall.
common_mistakes: Do not confuse a strip footing with isolated pad footings under individual columns.
Check steps and changes in bearing elevation rather than assuming one constant depth.

definition_en: A footing or foundation element supporting a building core, such as elevator, stair, or shear-wall core walls, often deeper or more heavily loaded than nearby foundations.
explanation_ru: Фундамент под ядром здания — например под стенами elevator/stair/shear-wall core. Он часто глубже и массивнее соседних footings, поэтому его excavation, working space и последовательность нужно проверять отдельно.
translation_ru: фундамент под лифтовым или лестничным ядром
translation_vi: móng khu lõi thang máy/cầu thang
example_en: The core footing requires a deeper excavation than the adjacent strip footings.
scenario: The elevator and stair core bears on a large foundation element that extends lower than the surrounding foundation system.
visual: Building section showing a deep foundation block beneath an elevator/stair core beside shallower foundations.
common_mistakes: Core footing is a functional description; the actual structural type may be a mat, strip, or other engineered foundation.
Measure its starting elevation from the correct structural level.

definition_en: Additional excavation clearance outside a footing, wall, chamber, or other structure so workers can install and remove forms, waterproofing, reinforcement, or other work safely.
explanation_ru: Рабочий зазор вокруг конструкции внутри котлована. Его добавляют к размеру excavation, когда снаружи footing/wall нужны формы, гидроизоляция или доступ людей. Если бетон можно лить прямо по грунту, отдельный working space может не требоваться — это зависит от метода и проекта.
translation_vi: không gian làm việc quanh hố đào
example_en: Add working space around the deep core foundation where formwork must be installed.
scenario: Workers need clearance between the excavation face and a formed concrete element so they can build, strip, and access the forms.
visual: Footing excavation section with a dimensioned clearance between the concrete form and excavation face.
common_mistakes: Do not add working space automatically to every footing.
Required clearance depends on means and methods, safety requirements, depth, formwork, and project details.

definition_en: Cutting excavation faces back at an engineered or permitted inclination instead of leaving them vertical, to reduce cave-in risk and maintain ground stability.
explanation_ru: Откос котлована — боковую стенку выемки делают наклонной, а не вертикальной. Допустимый угол зависит от грунта, глубины, воды, нагрузок и требований безопасности; его нельзя просто принимать по привычке.
example_en: Use excavation sloping where a vertical cut cannot be safely maintained without shoring.
scenario: A deep open cut has enough room to widen at the top, so the sides are laid back rather than supported vertically.
visual: Excavation cross-section comparing a vertical face with a laid-back inclined face.
common_mistakes: The safe slope is not universally 1:1 or 1.5:1.
Use the governing safety rules and geotechnical requirements for the actual ground conditions.

definition_en: A footing whose bearing elevation is locally lowered or stepped to maintain support, avoid interference, or satisfy required separation from adjacent deep utilities or excavations.
explanation_ru: Пониженный footing — участок фундамента опускают глубже, например рядом с глубоким manhole, chamber или utility trench, чтобы сохранить безопасную зону влияния и не подмыть основание.
example_en: Provide a dropped footing where the adjacent utility excavation would otherwise enter the foundation influence zone.
scenario: A deep chamber sits close to a shallow foundation, so part of the foundation must bear lower to avoid being undermined.
visual: Section showing a shallow footing stepping down beside a deeper utility structure.
common_mistakes: A dropped footing is not simply extra excavation under every foundation.
The required step or lowered elevation must follow structural/geotechnical design.

definition_en: The conceptual soil zone beneath and beside a footing or other supported element within which excavation or weakened ground may affect its support and stability.
explanation_ru: Зона влияния фундамента — область грунта, через которую нагрузка передаётся от footing. Глубокая траншея или manhole рядом не должны заходить в эту зону без инженерного решения; на чертежах её часто показывают наклонной линией от подошвы.
translation_vi: vùng truyền tải trọng nền móng
example_en: Check the zone of influence before accepting a deep chamber excavation beside an existing footing.
scenario: An adjacent deep excavation approaches the soil supporting a foundation, so an imaginary load-spread line is checked for interference.
visual: Footing section with diagonal influence lines extending downward and outward toward an adjacent deep excavation.
common_mistakes: Do not assume one universal slope ratio for the zone of influence.
The governing geometry comes from the project structural/geotechnical requirements.

definition_en: The design or required lowest elevation of an excavation before bedding, mud slab, concrete, or other subsequent material is placed.
explanation_ru: Отметка дна выемки — самая нижняя проектная отметка excavation. Для manhole, chamber, footing или trench её используют вместе с existing/proposed elevations, invert и толщинами bedding/gravel, чтобы получить глубину.
example_en: Use the bottom of excavation elevation to calculate the required depth of the chamber excavation.
scenario: A detail gives the lowest cut level below a structure before granular material or concrete is placed.
visual: Section with grade at top, a structure, and a dimension to the lowest excavation line below it.
common_mistakes: Bottom of excavation is not necessarily the same as pipe invert or underside of concrete.
Account for bedding, granular base, mud slab, or other layers shown in the details.

definition_en: Excavation required for below-grade mechanical or plumbing systems such as sanitary, storm, sumps, interceptors, chambers, and service piping.
explanation_ru: Выемка под mechanical/plumbing системы ниже плиты: трубы, manholes, interceptors, chambers и другие элементы. В takeoff важно измерять линии и отдельные boxes/pits, но исключать пересечения, уже учтённые в footing excavation.
translation_vi: đào cho hệ cơ điện ngầm
đào hệ thống ống dưới sàn
example_en: Measure the mechanical excavation by trench length and by separate pits for chambers and structures.
scenario: After the bulk cut, underground plumbing and mechanical services still require trenches and localized pits before the slab is poured.
visual: Plan and section showing utility trenches connecting several pits below a future slab.
common_mistakes: Mechanical excavation is a scope description, not a universal pay item.
Avoid double counting where a trench overlaps footing or chamber excavation already measured.

definition_en: An underground access or equipment structure used to house, connect, inspect, or maintain utility piping, valves, interceptors, or other service components.
explanation_ru: Подземная камера для размещения или обслуживания utility components. В отличие от обычной trench excavation, chamber обычно считают отдельным box excavation по плановым размерам, глубине и рабочему зазору.
example_en: Excavate the utility chamber before constructing the nearby shallow footing if the chamber is deeper.
scenario: A below-grade structure is larger than a pipe trench and provides access to utility equipment or connections.
visual: Underground rectangular chamber connected to incoming and outgoing pipes with an access opening at grade.
common_mistakes: A utility chamber is broader than a manhole; the exact function comes from the mechanical/civil drawings.
Do not assume all chambers have the same excavation allowance or working space.

definition_en: A plumbing or drainage device or chamber that separates or captures specified materials from a waste stream before flow continues to the downstream sewer system.
explanation_ru: Interceptor — устройство или камера на drainage/plumbing системе для отделения определённых загрязнений до попадания потока дальше в sewer. Это может быть grease, oil, sediment и другой тип; точное назначение всегда нужно смотреть по mechanical drawings/specifications.
translation_vi: thiết bị chặn/tách trong hệ thoát nước
example_en: Measure the interceptor as a separate structure excavation using its bottom elevation and base preparation.
scenario: A large below-grade unit sits in a drainage line and removes a specified contaminant before discharge downstream.
visual: Buried rectangular tank connected to inlet and outlet pipes with separated material settling inside.
common_mistakes: Interceptor is a generic term; verify whether the project means grease, oil, sediment, or another interceptor.
Do not infer the excavation dimensions from the pipe size alone.

definition_en: A prepared level working platform designed to support crane loads, often built with engineered granular fill, mats, concrete, or another specified system.
explanation_ru: Площадка под кран — подготовленное ровное основание, которое распределяет нагрузки от crane/outriggers. Для estimate нужно учитывать excavation, granular build-up, compaction и возможное removal/restoration, но состав зависит от engineered design.
example_en: Include a crane pad in the earthworks quantity if the lifting plan requires a dedicated working platform.
scenario: A large lifting machine needs a stable level platform that can safely carry concentrated setup loads.
visual: Crane with outriggers bearing on a prepared rectangular granular platform above compacted subgrade.
common_mistakes: A crane pad is not simply any flat gravel area.
Dimensions and bearing requirements must come from the lifting/geotechnical design.

definition_en: Planning the logical order in which construction activities occur so later work is not blocked, undermined, damaged, or forced to be reworked.
explanation_ru: Последовательность производства работ. На встрече ключевой принцип был: более глубокие элементы часто выполняются раньше более мелких, чтобы потом не подкапывать уже построенные foundations или services.
example_en: Review the construction sequencing where deep utility chambers are close to shallow foundations.
scenario: Several trades need the same area, and the order of excavation, underground services, foundations, and slab work affects rework and access.
visual: Four-step flow diagram showing deep utility work, foundations, backfill, and slab construction in sequence.
common_mistakes: The deepest-first approach is a useful planning principle, not an absolute rule for every project.
Quantity takeoff can sometimes be completed before the final field sequence is decided.

definition_en: A below-grade parking structure or parking garage, a term especially common in Canadian construction and real-estate usage.
explanation_ru: Подземный паркинг/гараж. В Британской Колумбии слово parkade очень распространено. В estimating существующий underground parkade важен для demolition, shoring и excavation, потому что существующие slabs/walls создают пустоты и ограничения по последовательности.
example_en: Exclude the existing underground parkade void from the soil volume when calculating bulk excavation.
scenario: An existing multi-level parking structure remains below grade inside part of a redevelopment site.
visual: Building section with ground level above multiple below-grade parking decks.
common_mistakes: Parkade is a Canadian term; parking garage is more common in many other regions.
Existing below-grade voids are not soil and should not automatically be counted as excavation volume.

definition_en: The planned removal, dismantling, breaking, or deconstruction of an existing building, structure, slab, pavement, or other constructed element.
explanation_ru: Демонтаж существующих конструкций. В tender review нужно точно определить, кто снимает building, slab, walls, foundations и underground structures, потому что граница demolition scope часто создаёт scope gaps.
example_en: Confirm whether the demolition scope includes the existing slab and below-grade foundation walls.
scenario: A redevelopment project removes an existing structure, but the tender documents are unclear about which below-grade elements remain.
visual: Existing wall and slab shown with dashed removal limits and debris arrows toward a haul truck.
common_mistakes: Do not assume above-grade demolition includes all below-grade slabs, walls, and footings.
Clarify interfaces between demolition, shoring, and excavation scopes.

definition_en: The contractor responsible for managing and coordinating the overall construction work, including its own work and subcontracted trade scopes.
explanation_ru: Генеральный подрядчик (GC) — компания, которая несёт общую ответственность за выполнение проекта и координирует subcontractors, procurement, schedule и scope interfaces.
example_en: The general contractor must confirm whether the remaining demolition is in its own scope or a trade package.
scenario: One company submits the overall bid to the owner and coordinates several specialty trade contractors.
visual: Simple organization chart with owner above one main contractor and several trade packages below.
common_mistakes: GC responsibilities depend on the contract and project delivery method.
Do not assume every scope gap is automatically performed by the GC.

definition_en: A company or trade contractor hired by another contractor to perform a defined portion of the construction work.
explanation_ru: Субподрядчик (часто просто sub) — отдельная компания, которая выполняет определённый scope, например shoring, hauling, concrete или ESC, по договору с GC или другим contractor.
example_en: Send the RFQ to more than one subcontractor when competitive coverage is needed for the trade.
scenario: A specialty company prices one trade package rather than the entire project.
visual: Main contractor box connected to several specialty trade boxes such as shoring, concrete, and utilities.
common_mistakes: A subcontractor's scope is defined by its proposal and subcontract, not just by trade name.
The lowest quoted total may not cover the same scope as competitors.

definition_en: A subcontractor's price proposal for a defined trade scope, including the stated price, inclusions, exclusions, qualifications, alternates, and commercial conditions.
explanation_ru: Предложение субподрядчика с ценой и условиями. Для estimator важно читать не только итоговую сумму, но и inclusions/exclusions/qualifications, потому что две цены могут покрывать разный scope.
example_en: Review each subcontractor quote for scope gaps before selecting the number to carry.
scenario: Several trade proposals arrive with different inclusions and exclusions even though they appear to price the same package.
visual: Comparison sheet showing three trade proposals with price, inclusions, exclusions, and notes.
common_mistakes: A low quote is not automatically the lowest complete cost.
Keep the original proposal and all clarifications traceable.

definition_en: The process of normalizing competing contractor or subcontractor proposals to a common scope so their prices and qualifications can be compared fairly.
explanation_ru: Выравнивание/нормализация коммерческих предложений. Estimator сравнивает inclusions, exclusions, quantities, alternates и qualifications и приводит bids к одинаковому scope перед выбором цены.
translation_vi: so sánh thầu trên cùng phạm vi
example_en: Complete the bid leveling before deciding which subcontractor number to use in the estimate.
scenario: Three proposals have different totals because each bidder included a different set of work, so the estimator creates an apples-to-apples comparison.
visual: Bid comparison matrix with common scope rows and bidder columns adjusted to comparable totals.
common_mistakes: Bid leveling is not simply sorting bids from lowest to highest.
Document every add, deduct, assumption, and scope adjustment.

definition_en: Estimator jargon meaning to include a particular cost figure or subcontractor price in the working estimate or bid.
explanation_ru: Estimator jargon: «заложить/нести эту цену в смете». Если говорят “we’ll carry their number”, значит именно эту цену используют в estimate как текущую стоимость данного scope.
translation_vi: đưa một mức giá vào dự toán
example_en: After leveling the quotes, carry a number that represents the selected complete scope.
scenario: Several prices are available for one trade and the estimator chooses one figure to include in the current estimate.
visual: Estimate sheet with one highlighted subcontract value flowing into the project total.
common_mistakes: Carrying a number does not necessarily mean the subcontract has been awarded.
Record whose price it is and what scope assumptions are attached to it.

definition_en: A preliminary cost estimate prepared to establish an expected project or scope cost before final bid-level information and firm pricing are available.
explanation_ru: Бюджетная оценка — предварительная стоимость, когда проект ещё не требует твёрдой bid price или находится далеко от construction. Обычно используют исторические цены, budget quotes и разумные assumptions, а не пытаются зафиксировать будущую цену.
translation_vi: ước tính chi phí sơ bộ
example_en: Use a budget estimate for the future phase instead of requesting firm trade pricing years in advance.
scenario: A later construction phase is still far from execution, so the team needs a reasonable planning number rather than a binding bid.
visual: Timeline showing conceptual design leading to a broad cost estimate before detailed bid pricing.
common_mistakes: A budget estimate is not a firm bid or guaranteed price.
State the basis, date, assumptions, and expected level of uncertainty.

definition_en: A temporary placeholder cost inserted into an estimate when firm pricing is not yet available, intended to be tracked and replaced or validated later.
explanation_ru: Временная заглушка в смете: estimator ставит разумную стоимость вместо ещё не полученной quote. Plug number помогает не оставлять ноль, но его нужно явно пометить и заменить/проверить до финальной подачи, если это bid.
translation_vi: giá tạm chèn vào dự toán
example_en: Use a plug number for the scope until a reliable quote or current budget rate is available.
scenario: A trade has no firm price yet, but the estimate cannot remain incomplete while the team continues working.
visual: Estimate spreadsheet with one highlighted placeholder cell and an arrow showing future replacement by a quote.
common_mistakes: A plug number is an internal estimating placeholder, not automatically a contractual allowance.
Track plugs so they are not silently treated as verified prices.

definition_en: A separate add or deduct price for an optional change in scope, method, material, or requirement, presented apart from the base price.
explanation_ru: Отдельная цена на вариант: заказчик или GC может попросить base price и дополнительную/вычитаемую стоимость, если определённый scope включается, исключается или меняется.
example_en: Ask the shoring bidder for an alternate price that excludes the specified optional anchor treatment.
scenario: The base proposal includes one scope, but the estimator also needs a separate add/deduct amount for a possible change.
visual: Proposal sheet showing one base total and a separate add/deduct alternate line.
common_mistakes: An alternate price should clearly state what changes from the base scope.
Do not mix an alternate into the base bid without documenting whether it was accepted.

definition_en: Water present below the ground surface within soil or rock, which can affect excavation stability, pumping, shoring, compaction, and foundation work.
explanation_ru: Грунтовые воды. Даже небольшой приток может влиять на excavation, shoring, pumping/dewatering, bearing surface и compaction. Уровень и ожидаемый приток нужно брать из geotechnical information и наблюдений, а не угадывать.
example_en: Review the groundwater conditions before selecting the excavation and dewatering approach.
scenario: Water begins entering a deep cut from the surrounding soil and affects the stability and dryness of the work area.
visual: Soil section with a water table line intersecting a deep excavation and arrows showing seepage.
common_mistakes: Groundwater level can vary seasonally and across a site.
Do not assume minor groundwater has no cost or schedule impact.

definition_en: Temporary and permanent measures used during construction to limit soil erosion and prevent sediment-laden runoff from leaving disturbed areas or entering drainage systems and waterbodies.
explanation_ru: Контроль эрозии и наносов (ESC): меры, которые не дают размытому грунту и мутной воде уйти с площадки в catch basins, storm system или водоём. Сюда относятся silt fence, inlet protection, stabilization, sediment control и maintenance.
translation_vi: kiểm soát xói mòn và bùn cặn
example_en: Include erosion and sediment control measures before starting major earth disturbance.
scenario: Rainfall can carry exposed soil from a construction area into storm drains, so temporary controls are installed and maintained.
visual: Graded site with silt fence, protected catch basin, stabilized stockpile, and runoff arrows.
common_mistakes: ESC is a system of measures, not only silt fence.
Requirements are project- and regulator-specific and need ongoing inspection and maintenance.

definition_en: Backfill material specifically selected or specified to meet required properties for placement around or beneath structures and utilities.
explanation_ru: Отборный/специально заданный материал обратной засыпки. Он должен соответствовать требованиям проекта по gradation, moisture, compaction и другим свойствам; это не просто любой excavated material.
example_en: Price the select backfill separately where imported material is required around the structure.
scenario: Excavated native soil cannot be reused in a sensitive zone, so a specified higher-quality material must be imported, placed, and compacted.
visual: Trench section showing a highlighted specified backfill zone around a structure above bedding.
common_mistakes: Select backfill properties vary by specification; do not assume one universal gradation.
